description: §6.7.4 rule 3: a writing scrml function handed on as a VALUE (never called in scrml) counts as called — E-EFFECT-WRITES-STATE.
rationale: §6.7.4 rule 3: "A **function value** — … a reference to a scrml function used as a value rather than called — appearing anywhere in the body counts as if it were called … A callback that writes state is therefore E-EFFECT-WRITES-STATE even though nothing in scrml calls it." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "`when` → outside-world effects only, spelled `<effect>`" — "your recs, except expound 3b, specifically why the engine restriction."
